info.name: accounting-system
info.description: Backend API for a multi-tenant, dual-currency ERP platform for Lebanese trading companies. See docs/API-DESIGN.md for envelope, pagination, and money-field conventions.

request.description: Authenticate with email + password. On success, the test script saves accessToken and refreshToken into the environment for use by every other request.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Invalid credentials

request.description: Creates a company and its first (owner) user atomically, then auto-logs in — same token pair shape as Log in. The test script saves accessToken, refreshToken, and companyId (decoded from the access token) into the environment.

response.name: 201 Created
409 Email or tax number already in use

request.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new access/refresh pair. Rotates the token: the old refresh token is revoked and cannot be reused.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Invalid, expired, or revoked

request.description: Revokes the given refresh token immediately, ending that session.
Returns the profile of the user identified by the current access token.
